description: This script performs a CI readiness check for a Flask backend application. It verifies whether environment variables DATABASE_URL and JWT_SECRET are set, and optionally tests the server's /health and /api/status endpoints to ensure the server is responsive.

methods.name: int fetch(url: str)
methods.description: Makes an HTTP GET request to the specified URL with a timeout of 3 seconds, returning the HTTP status code if successful, otherwise returns -1.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Main function that loads environment variables, checks critical environment variables, attempts to fetch health endpoints, and returns an appropriate exit code.
